title: Airport Terminal Passenger Queue Forecasting for Departure Gates and Security Checkpoints
venue: AIAA DATC/IEEE Digital Avionics Systems Conference (DASC)
summary: We develop a Transformer-based framework for forecasting passenger queues across airport facilities by jointly learning temporal dependencies and correlations among check-in islands, departure gates, and security checkpoints.

title: Multi-Agent Inverted Transformer for Flight Trajectory Prediction
venue: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems
summary: We introduce MAIFormer, a multi-agent trajectory prediction model that jointly captures each aircraft's spatio-temporal behavior and interactions among aircraft through multivariate and agent attention.

title: Probabilistic Multi-Agent Aircraft Landing Time Prediction
notes: Best Student Paper Award in Intelligent Systems
summary: We model aircraft landing times probabilistically while accounting for interactions among multiple aircraft, enabling both accurate predictions and explicit uncertainty estimation.

title: Learning to Explain Air Traffic Situation
venue: US-Europe Air Transportation Research & Development Symposium
summary: We investigate how attention learned from multi-agent aircraft trajectories can identify influential aircraft and provide interpretable representations of complex air traffic situations.

title: Aircraft Trajectory Dataset Augmentation in Latent Space
venue: International Journal of Aeronautical and Space Sciences
summary: We propose a latent-space aircraft trajectory augmentation framework that learns compact representations of flight trajectories and generates realistic synthetic trajectories while preserving the underlying structure of the original data.
